skonester_acm_faith_resolve_pick_group_effect = {
  remove_variable = skonester_acm_pick_group_name
  if = {
    limit = {
      OR = {
        scope:pick_doctrine = flag:special_doctrine_adoptionist_school_elipandic_doctrine
        scope:pick_doctrine = flag:special_doctrine_adoptionist_school_felicitous_doctrine
        scope:pick_doctrine = flag:special_doctrine_adoptionist_school_radical_doctrine
        AND = {
          has_variable = skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key
          OR = {
            var:skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:special_doctrine_adoptionist_school_elipandic_doctrine
        var:skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:special_doctrine_adoptionist_school_felicitous_doctrine
        var:skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:special_doctrine_adoptionist_school_radical_doctrine
          }
        }
      }
    }
    set_variable = {
      name = skonester_acm_pick_group_name
      value = flag:adoptionist_school
    }
  }
  else_if = {
    limit = {
      OR = {
        scope:pick_doctrine = flag:divine_destiny_doctrine
        AND = {
          has_variable = skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key
          OR = {
            var:skonester_acm_pick_doctrine_key = flag:divine_destiny_doctrine

  if = {
    limit = {
      has_variable = skonester_selected_faith_var
      has_variable = skonester_acm_pick_group_name
      NOT = { var:skonester_acm_pick_group_name = flag:doctrine_core_tenets }
    }
    if = {
      limit = {
        var:skonester_acm_pick_group_name = flag:adoptionist_school
      }
      var:skonester_selected_faith_var = {
        if = {
          limit = { has_doctrine = special_doctrine_adoptionist_school_elipandic_doctrine }

      }
